engine_identity_review.finding: The client enforces protocol major and exact product version but does not enforce semantic build identity. Existing WI047 evidence records an explicitly selected pre-merge engine with the same 3.1.3.dev1 identity that returned validation success while failing two mapping conformance cases (41/43). Maturin co-installs Python and Rust executables in one wheel and normal lookup is beside the Python environment, which reduces accidental mismatch; a same-version stale or mixed executable found there is still accepted.
